name: Account Access Problems
description: Customers report being unable to access their account.

name: General Access Problems
description: Customers report access issues, including a hacked account, trouble recovering playlists, or an unexplained token error.

name: Login Problems
description: Customers report rejected passwords, login failures, or connection errors that prevent logging in.

name: Charges for Basic Features
description: Customers object to charges for features such as repeating or skipping songs.

name: Paid Features and Restrictions
description: Customers complain that features and song choices are restricted or require payment.

name: Subscription Purchase and Access Issues
description: Customers report trouble purchasing a subscription or accessing premium features after paying.

name: Missing Songs and Music
description: Customers report that songs or music genres they want are unavailable.

name: Missing or Unavailable Lyrics
description: Customers report that lyrics are missing or fail to load.

name: Unwanted Song Recommendations
description: Customers report that recommendations continue appearing despite turning them off.

name: Downloads and Offline Listening Problems
description: Customers report that offline mode or downloaded content does not work or is unavailable.

name: Ads Make App Feel Like Advertisement
description: Customers describe the app as being dominated by advertisements.

name: General Dissatisfaction
description: Customers express broad dissatisfaction with the app or its policies.

name: Negative Reactions to Updates
description: Customers say a recent update made the app worse or led them to uninstall it.

name: App Crashes During Playback
description: Customers report that the app crashes when opened or while music is playing, particularly after an update.

name: Playback and Connection Problems
description: Customers report playback interruptions, loading problems, or trouble connecting while listening.

name: Playback Problems After Updates
description: Customers report that updates disrupted playback or song controls.

name: Negative Reaction to Support
description: A customer expresses a negative reaction to the app’s support.

name: Too Many or Loud Ads
description: Customers complain that ads are too frequent or too loud.

name: Limited Music Selection and Controls
description: Customers report being unable to choose, skip, repeat, or queue songs as they want.

name: Usability and Navigation Problems
description: Customers report difficulty finding or using app content and features.

name: Library and Discovery Difficulties
description: Customers report unwanted recommendations or difficulty finding and selecting songs and playlists.

name: Missing Features After Updates
description: Customers say updates removed basic music-player features or made the app harder to use.
